summary: Coherent decoding closes with the exact binomial output law. Circuit verification uses modular arithmetic plus final signed-range bounds, then a full four-coordinate census distinguishes positive, zero and negative correlation. The independent hardness proof restarts its definitions and lays out Gaussian-chain, derivative and martingale dependencies.
